name: Gamma-aminobutyric acid cetyl ester
summary: Cetyl-GABA, or CEGABA, also known as hexadecyl 4-aminobutanoate or as γ-aminobutyric acid (GABA) cetyl ester, is a GABA receptor agonist which has been used in scientific research. It is the cetyl (hexadecyl) ester of the major inhibitory neurotransmitter γ-aminobutyric acid (GABA).

uses.text: Cetyl-GABA, or CEGABA, also known as hexadecyl 4-aminobutanoate or as γ-aminobutyric acid (GABA) cetyl ester, is a GABA receptor agonist which has been used in scientific research. It was of interest as a potential anticonvulsant for therapeutic use to treat epilepsy, but was never marketed.
